senses.gloss: f. (fibula = pallium fibulatum, cmp. περόνημα a. πόρπαμα) clasp; a cloak fastened with clasps or buckles. Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Noah 21 נתן … טלית לשם וליפת פ׳ the Lord rewarded them, giving Shem the ṭallith (v. טַלִּית), and Japhet the pallium fibulatum; Gen. R. s. 36 ויפת לפִוְולָא and Japheth was granted the pallium; Yalk. ib. 61 לפלוניא (corrupt. of לפִיבוּלָא; some ed. פלמניא, corr. acc.).—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:3:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>היה הופך עיכליה דימינא וכ׳</he> (Matt. K. to <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:3">Lam. R. to IV, 2</cite> <cite ref="Q00575"><he>פִּיבְלֵיה</he></cite>) he changed the buckle from his right to his left shoulder; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 4:3:6">Y. Dem. IV, 24ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>פילכיה דשמלא לימנא</he> (read: <cite ref="Q00575"><he>פיבליה</he></cite>; Lam. R. l. c. <he>יד אונקלי</he>).
